text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI programs can generate impressive paintings, compose original music, and even write poems or short stories. Some people worry that this means machines will replace human artists. However, most experts believe AI is a tool, not a rival. While AI analyzes patterns and imitates existing styles, human creativity comes from personal experience, emotion, and the ability to break rules. A machine might produce a beautiful piece, but it cannot truly feel joy or sadness. The most exciting future may be one where artists and AI collaborate, pushing the boundaries of imagination in fresh, unexpected ways.
